sources.summary: EverMind has open-sourced EverOS, a local-first memory runtime that stores AI agent memory as plain Markdown indexed by SQLite and LanceDB. It combines hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, multimodal ingestion, and self-evolving Skills under an Apache 2.0 license. Here's what it is, how the architecture works, where the benchmarks stand, and where it still falls short — plus a runnable code walkthrough and an interactive demo. The post Meet EverOS: An Open Source Markdown-First Agent Memory Runtime With Hybrid BM25 + Vector Retrieval and Self-Evolving Skills appeared first on MarkTechPost .
